items.title: La editorial de Eminem, Eight Mile Style, demanda a Suno por presunta infracción de derechos de autor
items.summary: Eight Mile Style, la editorial que controla el catálogo de Eminem, presentó una demanda contra Suno alegando que la plataforma reprodujo obras protegidas sin autorización ni compensación, según el documento legal recibido por Digital Music News.

items.title: Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Infringement Lawsuits; Publisher Now Seeks Nearly $450 Million in Statutory Damages
items.summary: Reservoir Media has supersized its Suno and Anthropic copyright infringement complaints, which are now demanding a combined total of nearly $450 million in statutory damages. New York City-headquartered Reservoir fired off the expanded actions yesterday, weeks after submitting the original complaints. As we broke down…

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises Slaps Suno With Copyright & NIL Suit, Says the Platform Was ‘Always Meant to Replace the Artists Whose Works and Identities Were Being Unlawfully Copied’
items.summary: Another day, another AI infringement lawsuit – this time against Suno, which is accused of infringing a number of Elvis Presley copyrights as well as the King of Rock’s name, image, and likeness (NIL) rights. Plaintiffs including Elvis Presley Enterprises, Raleigh Music Publishing, and a subsidiary of Elvis IP owner Au…

items.summary: GameMill licensed the Peanuts characters but not Vince Guaraldi’s music, then copied Linus and Lucy and Skating, the complaint alleged. Source

ASCAP Names Samantha Saturn as General Manager, ASCAP Nashville
items.summary: Most recently, Saturn served for nearly eight years as chief marketing officer of SESAC Music Group.

items.title: Suno Bridge takes AI music to DAWs – starting with Ableton Live
items.summary: Suno building a bridge? No, this isn’t news of a licensing deal with any of the AI-music firm’s current litigants. Instead, it’s the latest step in the company’s efforts to position itself as a legitimate music-making tool for professionals. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Suno boss talks streaming fraud: ‘AI music is not a crime’
items.summary: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman has criticised what he describes as a “sleight of hand” of “equating streaming fraud with AI music”, while stressing that his company is doing more work behind the scenes to tackle fraud than people realise. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Guarda evidencia de la fecha de creación
tip.body: Un correo a ti mismo con el archivo adjunto, un repositorio con historial o un servicio de sellado de tiempo cuestan poco y construyen una línea de tiempo defendible.

items.title: Eminem’s Publisher Eight Mile Style Sues Suno Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Eight Mile Style, the publisher that controls Eminem’s catalog, filed a lawsuit against Suno claiming the AI platform reproduced copyrighted works without permission or compensation, with Digital Music News receiving an initial look at the complaint.

tip.title: Keep evidence of your creation date
tip.body: An email to yourself with the file attached, a repository with history, or a timestamping service cost little and build a defensible timeline.
